title: Osake wa Fuufu ni Natte kara: Yuzu Atsukan

synonyms: Osake wa Fuufu ni Natte kara Special
Love is Like a Cocktail Episode 14
alternative_titles.en: Love is Like a Cocktail: Fourteenth Glass - Yuzu Hot Sake
alternative_titles.ja: お酒は夫婦になってから 14杯め「ゆず熱燗」

synopsis:
Being busy with work lately, Chisato Mizusawa is afraid that she and her husband, Sora, cannot go on their yearly hot spring visit. While she is taking a bath, the always reliable bartender Sora decides to create a drink that will hopefully make Chisato feel like she is in an actual hot spring.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
